concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One concept image showing exactly FOUR stages of a completely ORIGINAL adorable pixel-art terminal pet, PLUMCAP: a cuddly walking mushroom with an oversized flattened plum-purple umbrella cap and a short pale lilac stem-body, no ears, no tail, no leaves. Four stages left to right baby, child, teen, adult. Baby a small squat mushroom button with a rounded wide cap; child broadens its low dome cap, teen develops two lobes in the brim, adult has a broad soft scalloped umbrella brim and a tiny tucked hand on either side of its short stem. Each stays squat and sweet rather than tall. Small clusters of two or three lavender highlight spots on the cap, asymmetrical upper-left lighting, dark aubergine warm 1-pixel outline, plum/mulberry cap, dusty mauve shadow, pale lavender stem, light pink-lilac highlight: no more than 5 fill colors. Face is on the stem below the cap, large enough for eyes at this scale but MUST BE COMPLETELY BLANK: no eyes, mouth, nose or facial marks, the engine adds these. Actual chunky clean low-resolution pixel art enlarged with nearest neighbor, no gradients, no painted texture, no thin lines. Heights about 9,11,13,15 pixels; widths about 13,16,19,21 pixels. Four grounded front-view sprites equally spaced on warm off-white paper background, aligned to baseline, no eggs, no text or labels, no accessories. Do not imitate any famous franchise or existing character. Preserve a distinctive mushroom silhouette with a cap substantially wider than its short stem.

Use case: stylized-concept. One concept sheet of exactly FOUR growth stages of a completely ORIGINAL cute nocturnal moth terminal pet called LUMA. A soft silver-blue fuzzy body with two stubby curved antennae and round indigo/periwinkle wings, like a tiny bedtime moth. Four stages left to right: baby a wide cuddly fuzzy grub with small rounded folded wing buds; child opens a pair of short round wings; teen grows broad scalloped upper wings and small lower wing lobes; adult has four soft rounded wing lobes spread horizontally like a plush bow, short antennae and tiny stub feet. A wide pale blue face on the central body, a compact large head and no long insect legs or proboscis. The facial patch MUST BE BLANK: no eyes, no mouth, no nose, no facial markings; game engine draws the face. Sparse one-pixel pale crescent-like accent at outer upper wing, no eyespots. Original design, no copying characters. Palette dark warm slate-violet 1-pixel outline, midnight-indigo wing shadow, muted periwinkle blue wing body, pale silver-blue face, almost white icy lavender upper-left highlight, maximum 5 fill colors. Each must look like readable chunky low-resolution pixel art enlarged nearest neighbor; baby 10 pixels high, child 11, teen 13, adult 15 high, all under 22 pixels wide. Front-facing grounded poses, consistent species through all stages, gentle cuddly silhouette. Four equally spaced sprites side by side on a warm off-white background. No text, no eggs, no props, no logos, no gradients, no polished vector art, no detailed texture.

Use case: stylized-concept. One pixel-art concept sheet of exactly FOUR growth stages of a completely ORIGINAL cute terminal pet called MOSSROLL: a chubby little land snail with a round moss-olive spiral shell carried behind a broad limestone-beige face and low soft crawling foot. The face sits at the LEFT side and faces the viewer, shell on RIGHT, horizontal asymmetric silhouette. Very short stubby feelers, no leaves, no animal ears. Baby a tiny low snail with a pebble-sized shell bump; child grows a round shell with the first small dark spiral; teen larger pronounced shell and a little upturned tail; adult rounded high spiral shell with a pale olive highlight and a broad soft creeping foot. Four stages side by side left to right aligned at ground, clear gradual growth: 9,11,13,15 pixels high and 14,17,20,22 wide maximum. Keep the face broad enough for later 2x2 eyes; NO EYES, MOUTH OR FACIAL MARKS on any stage, game engine adds these. Cute and friendly, minimal detail, chunky low-resolution pixel art enlarged with nearest neighbor, no blur or gradients. Warm dark brown 1-pixel outline, muted moss olive green shell, dark olive shell shadow/spiral, pale yellow-green shell highlight, warm limestone grey-beige body and ivory upper-left highlight, at most 5 fill colors. Dominantly moss olive and stone grey, not teal, orange, pink or yellow. Four equally spaced sprites on warm off-white backdrop, no text, labels, eggs, accessories, watermarks. Original design, do not copy any existing franchise character. Emphasize the shell and creeping horizontal form rather than an upright humanoid body.
